major_cooldowns.name: Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to massively increase rage generation and critical strike chance.

major_cooldowns.name: Odyn's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as a massive burst of AoE damage and rage generation, ensuring you are Enraged first.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use alongside Recklessness for massive AoE damage and passive rage.

defensives.name: Enraged Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Use for extreme self-healing via Bloodthirst and immediate damage reduction.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Use right before an incoming magic cast to reflect it and reduce magic damage taken.

defensives.name: Ignore Pain
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a rage dump for survivability when taking sustained damage.

rules.action: Always prioritize casting Rampage when available to maintain the Enrage buff, which is the core of Fury's damage.
Ensure Recklessness and Avatar are always pressed together to maximize burst damage.
Only cast Odyn's Fury while the Enrage buff is active to benefit from the mastery damage increase.
In multi-target situations, cast Whirlwind to buff your next single-target attacks to cleave onto additional enemies.

source_summary: Fury Warrior is an incredibly fast-paced, high APM spec focused entirely on generating rage rapidly to cast Rampage, thereby maintaining the Enrage buff.
